thread:
olivia: Quick planning thread for the Design Partner sprint starting Mon. Need final scope and feedback cadence. 10-15m sync?
raj: yes. My draft: 5 partners, 4 weeks, success artifacts = 20 curated prompts each + 2 recorded UX sessions.
lee: recommend 2-week onboarding ramp then 2-week evaluation window. otherwise partners get survey fatigue.
ana: (typo) -> ana: also recommend freeze on API surface changes during eval window. only infra fixes allowed.
jamie: recruitment note: target mix of 3 app-integrators + 2 platform teams. that gives variance in latency vs throughput needs.
olivia: good. Proposed launch gates: 1) partner adoption: >=60% daily active tasks completed for each partner cohort; 2) quality: no more than 2 major regressions across all partners; 3) latency: median token latency <120ms on dedicated sim.
raj: define major vs critical? I'll add a tiny taxonomy: critical = data exposure or system crash; major = consistent incorrectness that breaks the workflow; minor = UI/formatting.
lee: onboarding kit checklist: NDA, quickstart guide, sample prompts, escalation contacts, and a one-pager on how caching affects metrics.
ana: feedback loop: - weekly 45m product sync (recorded) - in-app lightweight two-question pulse (usefulness + top-issue) - shared collaborative doc for live notes - nightly automated eval on the smoke set
jamie: incentive idea: $300 credit + optional case-study co-auth for high-engagement partners. keeps expectations aligned.
olivia: ops need: include rollback strategy (variant fallback + rate-limit throttle) and partner-facing status page template.
ci-bot: ci:pilot-config-v2 deployed to staging by raj at 09:12am
raj: I'm locking the partner list today. Lee, can you confirm the onboarding checklist items are in the shared drive?
lee: confirmed, items are in /product/pilot-onboarding. I'll sync any changes by EOD.
olivia: finalize gating doc and post to #product by 5pm. If any blocker, ping me. Thanks all. :rocket:
